principle: Disaster events are recorded independently from mythos and ritual observations. Temporal or geographic proximity is never treated as proof of causation.

events.label: Karhutla / land fire
events.natural_or_human_cause: Vegetation fire during the dry-season karhutla period; no ritual mechanism is reported by the disaster source.

source.title: Perkembangan Situasi dan Penanganan Bencana di Tanah Air 3 Agustus 2026

causality.finding: This event predates the late-August Bangka ritual window and is retained as a seasonal baseline.

events.admin_area: Pemali / Sungailiat / Riau Silip, Kabupaten Bangka
events.label: Karhutla / multiple local fire reports
events.natural_or_human_cause: Official Pusdalops records show multiple land-fire reports during 26–27 August. The repository review treats dry conditions and human fire risk as stronger explanations than ritual causation.

source.title: Karhutla incident log — Kabupaten Bangka, 26–27 August 2026

causality.finding: Temporal overlap exists, but fires were already reported around/before the ritual period and human/dry conditions are stronger explanations.

events.label: Karhutla / detected fire points
events.natural_or_human_cause: Mempawah government reporting identified three fire points and an active 24-hour response operation. The source does not identify any ritual mechanism.

source.title: Posko Karhutla Mempawah Siaga 24 Jam, Tiga Titik Api Terdeteksi di Kecamatan Sadaniang

causality.finding: Fire risk and hotspots were already present; no mechanism linking the ritual to fire was found.

events.label: M7.7 earthquake + aftershock sequence
events.natural_or_human_cause: BMKG identifies a shallow thrust-fault earthquake sourced from the Flores Back-arc Thrust, followed by thousands of aftershocks.

source.title: Dinamika Gempa Flores M7,7: Sebaran dan Klaster Gempa Susulan di Zona Flores Back-arc Thrust

causality.finding: BMKG identifies Flores Back-Arc Thrust and the aftershock sequence as the mechanism.

events.label: Flood / hydrometeorological
events.natural_or_human_cause: BNPB reported flooding during a period when wet hydrometeorological events continued to occur alongside dry-season hazards.

source.title: Perkembangan Situasi dan Penanganan Bencana di Tanah Air 14 Agustus 2026

causality.finding: Hydrometeorological explanations prevail; no ritual mechanism is established.

context_signals.title: National hotspot escalation
context_signals.finding: Kementerian Kehutanan reported a sharp increase in hotspot detections across Sumatra and Kalimantan and explicitly cautioned that a hotspot is an indication of surface-temperature anomaly, not automatically a confirmed fire incident.
